items.title: 我向新版 DeepSeek 许了个愿，4 块钱让特斯拉飞起来
items.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 通过基于自反馈的强化学习，在 DeepSWE 榜单上超越 GPT-6.1 Sol 等闭源模型并跃居开源第一，同时将 3D 建筑重建能力提升至 BuildingBench 前五。利用该模型结合 Three.js 生成“特斯拉飞行”动态 3D 网页仅需消耗约 3752 万 Token，成本约为 4 元，远低于 GPT 等闭源模型 100 元以上的费用，实现了性能与费用的帕累托最优。
items.why_now: V4.1 Flash 1017 本周发布，3D 与编程能力登顶开源且成本仅 4 元，开启低价高性能开发窗口。
items.why_now_en: New DeepSeek V4.1 Flash tops open-source coding benchmarks.
items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash achieves top-tier coding performance, surpassing closed-source models like GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Fable 5 on DeepSWE benchmarks, while costing only approximately 4 yuan to generate a complex 3D interactive Tesla animation using 3.75 million input tokens with a 99.6% cache hit rate. The model's enhanced capabilities, driven by self-feedback reinforcement learning, extend to 3D scene reconstruction, game development, and video generation, offering a Pareto-optimal cost-performance ratio that makes one-off interactive demos and small-scale projects highly accessible compared to the 100+ yuan cost of equivalent tasks on competitors.

items.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-20261017 (Max) 登顶 Agent Arena 开源模型第一
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-20261017 (Max) 基于超 7.5K 真实会话数据，以每任务中位成本 $0.20（约为 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 27%）实现 Confirmed Success 提升 +11.5%，成为 Agent Arena 排名最高的开源模型。该模型在综合榜单中位列第 11，其性能提升幅度约为 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 37%，且彻底解决了 Tool Hallucination 问题，同时在 Praise vs. Complaint、Bash Reliability 及 Steerability 等多项指标中均位居开源模型第一。
items.why_now: DeepSeek最新模型以27%成本夺开源第一，Agent性价比窗口已至。
items.why_now_en: DeepSeek-V4.1 tops open-source Agent Arena at just 27% of GPT-6.1's cost.
items.summary_en: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-20261017 (Max) becomes the top-ranked open-source model on Agent Arena, securing an overall 11th place with a +5.1% net improvement across over 7,500 real-world sessions. It operates at a median task cost of $0.20—approximately 27% of the cost of GPT-6.1 Sol—while achieving 37% of that proprietary model's performance gains. The model leads open-source peers in Confirmed Success (+11.5%), Praise vs. Complaint (+5.9%), and Bash Reliability (+5.4%), notably without Tool Hallucination issues.

items.title: 🎙️ How I AI: Meta Muse Wonder + How Brooke Lacey is scaling video with AI
items.summary: Meta 的 Muse Wonder 模型在计费工单处理、收件箱分类和邮件写作等长程 Agentic 任务中表现强劲，其“主动聚焦”特性使其在多步推理和自然语音对话上超越同价位的 Opus 5.5 等竞品；然而该模型在前端设计与视频编辑上严重缺乏视觉精度和交互完整性，输出结果常伴有破损按钮和劣质字幕，因此仅被推荐用于后端代理工作流而非视觉交互场景。
items.why_now: Meta新发布Muse Wonder模型，其强大的多步代理能力为一人公司自动化工作流提供新选项。
items.why_now_en: Meta Muse Wonder just released: strongest agentic model at its price tier.
items.summary_en: Meta’s Muse Wonder model demonstrates superior agentic capabilities in its price tier, ranking first in benchmark tests for billing-ticket resolution, inbox triage, and computer use due to its "active focus" mechanism that correlates increased processing time with higher output quality. While the model excels at multi-step reasoning and natural email writing, it consistently fails in frontend design and video finishing, producing generic layouts with broken interactions and poor visual polish. Consequently, testers are deploying Muse Wonder for knowledge-work orchestration and personal agents, while reserving its use for non-design-focused workflows to avoid its weaknesses in visual fidelity.

items.title: Mercury 3: Diffusion at scale
items.summary: Mercury 3 是迄今最强扩散式 LLM，其参数量比 Mercury 1 扩大 40 倍以上，智能水平提升 3 倍，在多项基准测试中性能超越 GPT-6 Luna 和 Claude Haiku 5.5。该模型在 NVIDIA GPU 上运行速度达 1,068 tokens/秒，支持 1M 上下文（前代仅 260K），定价为输入 $0.20/百万 tokens、输出 $0.70/百万 tokens（首发五折），已在浏览器代理、实时搜索及客服等对延迟敏感的场景中大规模落地。
items.why_now: 首发5折窗口期，以$0.10/M极低价格体验GPT-6级速度与智能，适合即刻构建实时应用。
items.summary_en: Mercury 3, a diffusion-based LLM scaling 40x larger than its predecessor, delivers 1,068 tokens per second on NVIDIA GPUs and features a 1M-token context window. It outperforms GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 in quality while operating at 4–8x the speed of frontier models, offering a 50% introductory price of $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.35 per million output tokens. Early-access partners deploy the model for latency-sensitive applications, where it achieves a 50% success rate on Mind2Web navigation tasks and maintains median end-to-end response times of 2.2 seconds for real-time search agents.

items.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
items.summary: MiniMax M3.1 Flash在复杂智能体任务、编码、计算机使用及网络安全基准测试中达到行业领先水平，其中DeepSWE得分73.7%、OSWorld V2得分61.7分并位列中国模型第一。该模型通过更激进的稀疏性优化，实现日常输出速度200+ TPS，在线推理速度提升近3倍。其定价极具竞争力，输入价格$0.15/百万tokens，整体使用成本较前代降低70%。
items.why_now: MiniMax M3.1 Flash今日上线，推理提速3倍且成本直降70%，确立新性价比标杆。
items.summary_en: MiniMax M3.1 Flash introduces a next-generation agent model that improves online inference speed by nearly three times and reduces usage costs by 70% compared to its predecessor, while achieving top-tier performance in agentic tasks, coding, computer use, and cybersecurity. Key benchmarks include 73.7% on DeepSWE v1.1, 61.7 on OSWorld V2, and 82% on CyberGym, with inference speeds reaching over 200 TPS. The model is available via API with flat pricing of $0.15 for input and $0.60 for output per million tokens.

items.title: Timestral: Mistral's time-series foundation models
items.summary: Mistral 推出的 Timestral 时序基础模型家族包含 5M 至 209M 四种参数规模，其最大模型以仅 209M 参数在 GIFT-Eval、TIME 和 fev-bench 三大基准测试中全面超越现有最先进水平，性能优于参数量为其三倍以上的 Chronos-2 及参数量更多的 TimesFM-3 和 Falcon-2.0。该模型支持概率性与多变量预测，结合合成预训练、协变量感知注意力机制及长上下文学习技术，显著优于传统的 ARIMA 和 PatchTST，且无需 GPU 即可在 CPU 上高效运行，209M 模型在标准服务器 CPU 上单次预测耗时仅 140ms，适用于零样本预测及领域适配微调。
items.why_now: Mistral刚发布Timestral，以209M参数登顶三大基准，CPU秒级推理，零样本可用。
items.summary_en: Mistral’s Timestral family of time-series foundation models, featuring four sizes ranging from 5M to 209M parameters, ranks first on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench by outperforming previous state-of-the-art models with only two-thirds of the parameters. The 209M model delivers state-of-the-art probabilistic, multivariate forecasts using synthetic pre-training and covariate-aware attention, while the entire family operates efficiently on CPUs without GPUs, taking as little as 10 ms for the 5M model to forecast one day ahead.

items.title: fal 联合 bfl_ai 发布后训练视频模型 FLUX 3 Max
items.summary: fal 与 bfl_ai 联合发布后训练视频模型 FLUX 3 Max，在第三方图生视频质量评测中并列第一，且生成 10 秒 720/768p 视频仅需约 12 秒。该模型未来三周提供 75% 折扣，被标注为同质量级别下最便宜的前沿视频模型。
items.why_now: FLUX 3 Max 未来三周享75%折扣，为当前同质量最便宜视频模型。
items.why_now_en: 75% off for three weeks: cheapest frontier video model.
items.summary_en: fal Research and bfl_ai released the post-trained video model FLUX 3 Max, which ranks first in independent third-party image-to-video quality benchmarks and generates 10-second 720/768p clips in approximately 12 seconds. For the next three weeks, the model offers a 75% discount, making it the most affordable frontier video model in its quality tier.

items.title: Inception 扩散模型 Mercury 3 上线 OpenRouter
items.why_now_en: 五折折扣仅限上线期，价格$0.10/M。
items.summary_en: Inception’s diffusion model Mercury 3 is now available on OpenRouter, delivering over 1,000 tokens per second with a 1M-token context that is four times larger than Mercury 2.5. The model outperforms GPT-6 Luna and Haiku 5.5 on IFBench, GPQA Diamond, and SWE-Bench Atlas, and is offered at a 50% launch discount with pricing of $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.35 per million output tokens.

items.title: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
items.summary: Anthropic 官方推出 Claude Code 插件目录，分为内部与第三方两类，用户可通过 `/plugin install {plugin-name}@claude-plugins-official` 直接安装或浏览发现。该目录定义了包含 `plugin.json` 元数据及可选 MCP 服务器、命令、智能体等组件的标准结构，并强制规定插件名为不可变标识符，若需变更须通过 `displayName` 或 `marketplace.json` 中的重命名映射机制自动迁移用户安装记录，第三方插件提交则需通过质量与安全审核。
items.why_now: Claude Code插件官方目录已上线，一人开发者可即刻通过市场安装与分发扩展。
items.why_now_en: Claude Code plugins are now officially installable
items.summary_en: The official Claude Code plugins directory, hosted at code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins, structures distribution into Anthropic-maintained and third-party tracks, enabling installation via the command /plugin install {plugin-name}@claude-plugins-official. Plugins utilize a standard architecture featuring a required .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest and optional components for MCP servers, slash commands, and agents. The system supports skill-bundle plugins that map specific SKILL.md paths from Git repositories, while enforcing immutable plugin slugs for installation stability and relying on a dedicated renames map within .claude-plugin/marketplace.json to handle migration for UI label changes.

items.title: akitaonrails/ai-memory
items.summary: 开源项目 ai-memory 通过 Git 支撑的 Markdown 存储实现跨 20 多个编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor）及多机器的共享长期记忆，支持会话完整移交且无需重新解释架构。其核心机制基于生命周期钩子自动捕获数据，并在默认路径下实现零 LLM 调用的检索与记忆衰减管理，避免了对 API 密钥的依赖。
items.why_now: 该开源工具已支持20+编码代理互通，能即时解决跨厂商切换导致的上下文丢失痛点。

items.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
items.summary: “dumbtv”和“cleanyourtv”等开源项目利用AI（如Claude Code、Deepseek V4.1 Flash、Claude Opus/Sonnet 5.5）通过Wi-Fi远程重构Android TV和Fire TV，在无需Root权限的情况下移除内置广告、禁用自动内容识别（ACR）追踪并替换臃肿的启动器。例如，cleanyourtv项目上线两天内便有数千用户成功优化了Xiaomi、TCL、Sony、LG等品牌电视，Mihir Gupta等用户更通过AI将192MB的默认启动器替换为83MB的自定义版本并禁用了25个预装应用，显著提升了界面响应速度。
items.why_now: Claude Code 刚实现“vibe coding”直连电视去广告，数百万用户两日内自发部署。
items.why_now_en: Claude Code viral hacks already deflating smart TV ad revenue.
items.summary_en: Developers and users are leveraging AI agents like Claude Code to "vibe-code" smart TVs, creating open-source solutions such as "dumbtv" and "cleanyourtv" that strip bloatware, disable tracking, and replace clunky launchers with streamlined interfaces on platforms including Android TV, Fire TV, and devices from Sony, TCL, and LG. The process typically involves no root access, utilizing AI to generate and execute over-the-air Wi-Fi modifications that have seen thousands of users adopting the fixes within days of viral GitHub posts.

items.title: Meta 详解 Thin Orchestrator 模式：让路由少干活提升 AI 智能体可靠性
items.why_now_en: Meta just published a battle-tested, open blueprint for agent architecture.

items.title: n8n 教程：在 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上离线运行全套 AI 工作流
items.summary: 在 NVIDIA DGX Spark（128GB 统一内存）上可离线部署七个本地模型，并通过 LiteLLM 提供单一 OpenAI 兼容端点驱动 n8n 工作流，实现全程无云 API 调用。
items.why_now_en: Local LLMs now match cloud perf on DGX Spark, enabling zero-cost AI workflows today.
items.summary_en: An n8n tutorial details how to deploy seven local AI models on an NVIDIA DGX Spark (128GB unified memory) to run workflows entirely offline without cloud API calls. The implementation uses LiteLLM to create a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint that drives the n8n nodes, enabling a fully local AI stack.

items.title: Show HN: Claude Code skills and hooks that prove a fix's test fails without it
items.summary: 该工具包为 Claude Code 提供了一套包含 Skills 和 Hooks 的工程化工作流，核心机制是“Supervisor”将任务分发给 Haiku、Sonnet 和 Opus 等不同层级的模型，并强制执行 TDD 流程，要求测试必须在未修复 bug 时失败以证明修复的有效性。其通过 exit code 作为验证门槛，并利用 `regression-proof` 技能在合并基准的 scratch worktree 中验证测试的回归属性，最后通过 `handoff` 命令生成会话交接笔记以实现上下文延续。
items.why_now: Claude Code 插件生态刚开放，agent-workflow 已上架，一人公司可即刻安装实现自动化研发流程。
items.why_now_en: Free Claude Code tier routing slashes model costs now.

items.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
items.summary: Tenstorrent 以 62 亿美元估值完成 15 亿美元融资，较 2024 年底的 26 亿美元估值翻倍，资金将用于扩展针对开放权重 AI 模型及视频生成定制的推理芯片。CEO Jim Keller 确认公司 Galaxy 服务器成功运行 DeepSeek 模型，据此选择保持独立并推进新一轮融资，以在 NVIDIA 主导的市场中通过支持开源大模型部署实现差异化竞争。
items.why_now: Tenstorrent估值超2.5倍跃至62亿美元，独立募资竞逐英伟达，开放权重芯片窗口正开。
items.why_now_en: Open-weight chip funding window is open now.
items.summary_en: Tenstorrent raised $1.5 billion at a $6.2 billion valuation, more than doubling its previous $2.6 billion valuation, to accelerate chip development for open-weight AI inference and video generation. Led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, the round follows earlier acquisition interest from Intel and Qualcomm, as CEO Jim Keller pivots the company toward independence to challenge Nvidia's dominance in the AI hardware market.

items.title: Apate.ai 用35万个AI反诈拖住骗子，国内年轻人用AI视频反制AI卖惨账号
items.summary: 澳大利亚公司 Apate.ai 部署了 35 万个 AI 诈骗诱饵，与骗子完成 250 万次对话并消耗其约 17 年有效时间，致使 TPG 运营商 59 万通可疑来电被拦截，澳洲联邦银行公开报告的诈骗损失下降 76%，该公司已于今年 8 月融资 815 万美元。
items.why_now: Apate.ai 刚获815万美元融资，其AI反诈方案助银行损失降76%，验证商业闭环，反诈SaaS迎上市窗口。
items.why_now_en: Apate.ai刚融$8.15M，反诈AI变现窗口已开
items.summary_en: Australian company Apate.ai deployed 350,000 AI bot victims to conduct 2.5 million chats, wasting scammers' time equivalent to 17 years, which contributed to a 76% reduction in reported fraud losses for the Commonwealth Bank. The company secured $8.15 million in seed funding in August following its collaboration with carrier TPG, which diverted nearly 590,000 suspicious calls to these AI systems.

items.title: “Claude cuts my TikTok”: How this creator is scaling video with AI | Brooke Lacey
items.summary: Brooke Lacey 利用 Claude Code、FFmpeg 和 Whisper 构建自动化工作流，将原始手机视频剪辑为 TikTok 短内容的耗时缩短至约 15 秒，并通过向 Claude 植入其跳跃剪辑节奏和钩子逻辑来保持内容风格一致性。她每周仅发布一次内容，依靠挖掘 TikTok 评论区作为新脚本来源实现运营闭环，同时借助该无剪辑师模式维持 TikTok 粉丝数突破 29 万。
items.why_now: Claude Code 结合 FFmpeg 实现15秒自动剪辑，为一人公司提供零门槛AI视频规模化生产工具。
items.why_now_en: Claude Code now auto-edits TikToks in 15 seconds

items.title: Designing the Wait: Async AI Generation UX for Products That Take Minutes
items.summary: 针对耗时约10分钟的AI生成任务（如Burning Bridges Studio的照片转视频功能），应将工作建模为持久化的 `GenerationTask` 记录而非临时HTTP请求，并明确状态枚举（queued, running, ready, failed）以支持断点续查和计费审计。界面设计需摒弃虚假进度条，直接展示预计时长、当前阶段及最后更新时间，并将“二次访问”视为常态，通过任务列表支持用户离线管理、自动退款及重试操作。最终输出应提供可下载的独立文件（如15秒16:9 MP4）而非封闭预览，以增强产品传播力并解决网络中断后的提交确认问题。
items.summary_en: Burning Bridges Studio models its 10-minute photo-to-video generation as a persistent task record rather than a blocking HTTP request, enabling users to poll status or revisit jobs across sessions without losing progress. The UX design prioritizes honest time estimates over fake progress bars, displays clear stage updates, and implements automatic credit refunds for failures to reduce support friction. Users can access historical tasks through a searchable list and download the final 15-second, 16:9 MP4 files directly, ensuring outputs remain portable and shareable.

items.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
items.summary: Anthropic正与Nscale洽谈另一笔规模达450亿美元的算力协议，此前双方一个月前刚签署了同等金额的算力交易。尽管部分投资者担忧巨额算力支出回报率低，Anthropic仍持续推进此类合作，目前两家公司均在筹备IPO，其中Nscale拟以300亿美元估值上市，但正面临投资者对该估值的抵制。
items.why_now_en: Nscale's $30B IPO valuation faces pushback this week.
items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports that Anthropic and Nscale are nearing a second $45 billion compute deal, following a similar partnership announced just over a month ago. Both companies are currently pursuing IPOs, with Anthropic expected to go public this year and Nscale facing investor pushback on its proposed $30 billion valuation amid broader market concerns over the profitability of massive AI infrastructure spending.

items.title: Anthropic designs a pay package for the public
items.summary: Anthropic 推出公共福利基金（Public Benefit Fund），若股东批准将分得公司 5% 的股权（按 5 月估值约 480 亿美元），该基金作为有限责任公司可支持非营利组织或向受 AI 影响的群体直接分配资金。随着 Anthropic 估值每增长 50%，董事会可额外增加 2% 的分配比例，目前该公司约 20% 的股份已预留用于公共利益。此举旨在通过实际股权分配应对公众对 AI 信任度下降的问题，并配合其此前承诺的 2 亿美元就业冲击研究计划。
items.why_now: Anthropic刚发布公 benef 基金，若股东批准将获5%股权，AI巨头正首次用真金白银重塑行业信任。

items.title: Making the internet better for AI agents might make it worse for everyone else
items.summary: OpenAI的Dots和Meta的Muse等应用大规模推出个人AI代理，导致8月至9月代理网络流量激增三倍，Muse单月下载量达500万。由于这些代理代表用户执行预订等任务却缺乏身份验证机制，亚马逊封锁了Muse和Perplexity的代理，而Shopify则通过设立专用结账通道向代理开放电商流量。随着代理在机器速度下重塑以人为核心的网络架构，人类用户将面临更频繁的验证干扰及被优化为优先服务代理的劣化界面体验。
items.why_now_en: Shopify just opened agent-only checkout lanes.
items.summary_en: The launch of personal AI agents like Meta’s Muse, which drove 5 million downloads in its first month and tripled agentic web traffic from August to September, is forcing a third category of web users that traditional bot-human distinctions fail to accommodate. This shift has triggered resistance from major platforms like Amazon, which is suing Perplexity to block agent traffic that disrupts advertising metrics, while Shopify is adapting by creating dedicated agent checkout lanes. Experts warn that optimizing the internet for machine-speed agents may degrade human user experiences, resulting in more restrictive verification systems and neglected interfaces for people.

items.title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
items.why_now: Character.AI 近期破产清算，AI 伴侣赛道竞争格局真空，Tolan 趁此窗口期融资扩张。
items.why_now_en: Character.AI's bankruptcy clears the space for Tolan
items.summary_en: Tolan raised a $30M funding round led by Union Square Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Homebrew, valuing the company at over $268M according to PitchBook estimates. The AI companion app achieves annual recurring revenue in the double-digit millions via tiered memberships, serving over 250,000 active users who have generated 70 million conversations, with a user base comprising 70% women and 40% parents.

items.title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
items.why_now: Wabi本周一正式全量上线，直接对标Instinct和Muse等新兴个人AI助理。
items.why_now_en: Wabi launched for all users this Monday.
items.summary_en: Eugenia Kuyda, founder of Replika, officially launched Wabi, a multiplayer personal AI assistant that operates as a messenger app with multiple agentic threads for dedicated tasks and goals. The platform raises $20 million in pre-seed funding and differentiates itself from competitors like Muse and Instinct by using a multithreaded architecture to prevent context degradation and offering a "multiplayer" feature that allows users to share custom-built apps in group chats. In this evolution from its initial social prompt-sharing focus, Wabi’s agent automatically builds and manages specific apps—such as relationship trackers or family schedules—upon connecting to user email and calendar data.

items.title: MemSilicon完成超 4 亿元 A 轮融资，宣布战略升级
items.summary: 铭芯启睿（MemSilicon）完成由博原资本领投、小米战投等跟投的超4亿元A轮融资，用于推进RRAM产业化及新一代LPU研发；前Graphcore总裁卢涛加入担任CEO，公司战略升级至存算协同领域，聚焦利用内存架构创新解决大模型推理中“低延迟、长上下文”的瓶颈，以提供高速Token解码能力。

items.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
items.summary: 微软发布“Guardian Agents”功能及扩展的Microsoft Defender代理检测模块（可识别包括Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw在内的60种代理），旨在监控不受信任的前沿AI模型，将“智能供应”与“控制权”分离，以防已部署的AI代理像内部威胁者一样因不可预测性而危害企业敏感数据。此举虽与微软对OpenAI和Anthropic的既有投资关系存在利益冲突，但通过限制代理权限、实施动态权限调整及引入人类审批机制，确立了独立于模型提供商的安全审计逻辑。
items.summary_en: Microsoft introduced Guardian Agents within Project Perception, expanding its original red, blue, and green team framework to monitor and control enterprise AI agents, which CEO Satya Nadella characterizes as "insider threats" due to their unpredictable access to sensitive data. To enforce the principle of separating intelligence supply from authority, Microsoft added agent detection to Microsoft Defender, capable of identifying up to 60 types of third-party agents such as Claude Code and Codex, alongside features that limit data access and mandate human approval for high-risk actions.

items.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
items.summary: 开源AI编程工具OpenCode的在线平台OpenCode Console遭遇大规模AI驱动的数据蒸馏攻击，导致1.4%用户的API密钥泄露，部分用户产生了数百至上千美元的未授权费用。OpenAI、Anthropic和Google迅速行动，分别通过退款、封锁或协助恢复访问来应对泄露事件。此次事件凸显了AI安全护栏在防御场景中的局限性，即前沿模型因触发安全过滤器而拒绝分析攻击代码，迫使OpenCode等团队依赖OpenAI的Daybreak Blue计划等低限制模型进行安全响应。
items.summary_en: OpenCode disclosed that a security breach in its OpenCode Console exposed API keys for 1.4% of users, enabling attackers to run up over $1,000 in unauthorized charges on individual accounts via a large-scale distillation attack. The incident highlighted the "asymmetry problem," where safety filters in frontier models obstructed OpenCode’s defensive analysis, forcing the team to rely on OpenAI’s Daybreak Blue program for unrestricted access to investigate the exploit. In response to the attack, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google disabled the compromised keys, with OpenAI also refunding affected customers for credits consumed during the breach.

items.title: 美国国土安全部下令所有联邦文职机构移除 DeepSeek 及基于其开发的产品
items.summary: 美国国土安全部依据2018年供应链法发布2026-01号命令，要求所有联邦文职机构立即停止采购并从IT系统中移除DeepSeek及其关联产品，该禁令明确涵盖使用DeepSeek开发的第三方工具及衍生服务。此命令针对部署于中国服务器且被指存在数据泄露风险的DeepSeek模型（其最新Flash模型在编程任务上已超越Claude Opus 5），迫使向联邦供货的AI厂商必须对模型组件进行溯源合规，且设有60天窗口期供机构申请例外。
items.summary_en: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security issued Directive 2026-01, mandating that all federal civilian agencies immediately cease procurement of and remove DeepSeek's products from IT systems, explicitly including third-party tools and services built on the open-weights model. This action, authorized under the 2018 Supply Chain Act and signed by Secretary Markwayne Mullin, cites risks that DeepSeek's Chinese-based servers and data collection practices could expose sensitive government information to Beijing's intelligence apparatus. By requiring AI vendors supplying the federal government to disclose embedded model components, the directive extends compliance burdens across the broader AI sector, marking the most far-reaching U.S. restriction on a specific foreign AI laboratory to date.

items.title: FBI 称前 OpenAI 工程师涉嫌窃密，手机中发现 Saudi Gov Docs 文件夹
items.summary: FBI指控前OpenAI工程师Abdulrahman Alfozan涉嫌在绝密会议室安装定制加密窃听器，其iPhone中被发现名为“Saudi Gov Docs”的文件夹，且他曾利用OpenAI生产力智能体搜索适合安放的会议室及高管名单。检方证据显示，Alfozan（年薪32.5万美元，持有价值220万美元股权）与沙特王室成员保持联系，并预订了由沙特政府支付飞往利雅得的单程机票，其妻儿在随后飞离美国。尽管Alfozan目前仅面临最高五年刑期，但法院已批准羁押申请，美国司法部强调其利用窃密行为辅助沙特“Vision 2030”AI计划，存在重大潜逃及危害国家安全风险。
items.summary_en: Abdulrahman Alfozan, a former OpenAI engineer earning a base salary of $325,000 and a $2.2 million equity grant, was denied bail after the FBI uncovered a "Saudi Gov Docs" folder on his iPhone and evidence he used OpenAI’s productivity agents to optimize hidden recording devices in secure conference rooms. Investigators allege he was recruited by a Saudi royal family member via WhatsApp and coordinated the extraction of his family to Saudi Arabia using government-funded flights to Riyadh and Doha, citing Saudi Arabia’s "Vision 2030" AI push as the motive. Alfozan faces up to five years in prison for illegally recording meetings involving government officials and OpenAI executives, with authorities arguing the threat of foreign espionage and his financial resources necessitate pretrial detention.

items.title: AI Proved the Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis. What Happens Now?
items.summary_en: OpenAI announced the proof of the quasi-Riemann Hypothesis, a result described by Stanford professor Jared Duker Lichtman as the most significant AI-for-math achievement to date, resolving a weaker variant of the 160-year-old Riemann Hypothesis. The proof, which synthesizes well-known ideas without introducing new concepts, has staggering implications for understanding prime numbers and builds on techniques pioneered by Maksym Radziwiłł and Alexander Dunn.

items.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
items.summary: AWS推出TorchNeuron工具，允许开发者仅需修改一行配置即可将基于PyTorch的AI应用无缝迁移至自研Trainium芯片，无需重写代码。尽管Nvidia长期通过CUDA生态绑定PyTorch默认架构，但AWS强调Trainium支持训练与推理一体化，并声称Deepgram等客户借此实现了每美元处理70%更多音频的性价比优势。

items.summary_en: A free local realtime talking avatar application generates lip-synced video on an RTX 4090 at 90+ FPS, eliminating the need for expensive hosted services like Tavus or Lemonslice. Users can attach the avatar to existing voice agents by selecting a static image, enabling low-cost GPU-based face generation without per-minute usage fees.

items.title: Beware of AI Content for SEO
items.summary: Google 近期更新了 SEO 指南，强调“人为优先”的 EEAT 标准，并警告大规模滥用 AI 生成内容将违反垃圾内容政策，导致如 xAI 的 Grokopedia 上线后迅速因排名被大幅降低。在 AI 辅助 SEO 的正确策略中，应仅将其用于元描述、产品规格说明及内容大纲等辅助组件，同时严禁使用 AI 撰写声称具备原创见解的完整文章、社交媒体帖子或具有法律效力的文件，所有内容均需人工校对以确保准确性。
items.summary_en: Google has updated its spam policies to penalize scaled AI-generated content that lacks EEAT (experience, expertise, authoritativeness, and trust), a shift underscored by the rapid de-ranking of xAI’s Grokopedia after it launched in October 2025. While a June 2026 research paper by Google analyst Abhinav Mathur highlights the growing challenge of detecting "AI slop," the guidelines now encourage creators to disclose AI usage and prioritize original, high-effort content. To maintain organic visibility, businesses should restrict generative AI use to ancillary tasks like meta descriptions, outlines, and data-driven charts, while avoiding it for full articles, social media posts, and legal documents that require genuine human insight and review.

items.title: How helped scale a travel agency from $3,000 to $20,000 in monthly profits within 6 months
items.summary: 该案例通过引入 Airtable 管道管理，强制实施“2 小时内首次响应”及“第 1、3、7、14 天固定跟进”规则，将合格线索的报价成交率从 8-9% 提升至 15%，同时零广告支出优化了获客效率。通过砍占营收 58% 但毛利仅 21% 的机票业务，转向主推面向家庭和长线多国旅行的定制套餐，使其毛利占比近三分之二并显著提升了客单价。最终，该机构在 6 个月内实现月收入从 3,000 美元激增至 20,000 美元，利润率提升约 7 倍。
items.summary_en: A two-person travel agency scaled monthly profits from $3,000 to $20,000 in six months by implementing an Airtable pipeline with strict response and follow-up protocols, which increased the quote-to-close rate from 8-9% to 15% without additional ad spend. The agency repositioned its offer from low-margin flights (58% of revenue, 21% of gross profit) to high-margin curated packages (under 25% of revenue, nearly two-thirds of profit) by targeting families for longer multi-country trips, nearly doubling the average package value.

directions.name: 3D Web Snapshot
directions.description: 利用 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 低成本优势，将文字描述或 URL 实时转换为交互式 Three.js 3D 网页片段并生成分享链接的工具。
directions.description_en: A tool that leverages the cost-efficiency of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to convert text descriptions or URLs into interactive Three.js 3D web snippets and generate shareable links in real-time.
directions.target_user: 独立开发者、UI/UX 设计师、内容创作者
directions.target_user_en: Indie developers, UI/UX designers, content creators
core_features: 自然语言生成 Three.js 代码
一键导出及托管 3D 网页片段
core_features_en: Natural language to Three.js code generation
One-click export and hosting of 3D web snippets
directions.why_now: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 在 BuildingBench 前五的表现加上 4 元成本生成复杂 3D 场景的帕累托最优，使得 3D 网页生成的边际成本急剧下降，社区对其开源低成本优势的讨论热度极高，正是构建低成本 3D Web 内容分发平台的时机。
directions.why_now_en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash's top-5 BuildingBench performance and the Pareto-optimal cost of 4 RMB for complex 3D scenes drastically reduce the marginal cost of 3D web generation. High community discussion on its open-source cost advantage makes this the perfect time to build a low-cost 3D Web content distribution platform.
directions.monetization: 按 3D 场景渲染次数订阅 + 高级导出格式（GLTF/OBJ）API 调用付费
directions.monetization_en: Subscription based on 3D scene render counts + paid API calls for advanced export formats (GLTF/OBJ)
